subject.title: improve(ui): unify new-thread folder and where pickers into one place picker

question: Should the Control UI adopt the unified place-picker interaction as the canonical new-thread destination and folder workflow?
rationale: This changes the primary new-thread workflow and its information architecture; correctness evidence cannot determine whether this UX direction is the intended product standard.

options.title: Adopt the unified picker
options.body: Accept the one-place workflow after a Control UI owner confirms that its recents, progressive destination disclosure, and browser navigation are the desired interaction model.

options.title: Keep split controls
options.body: Retain separate folder and destination controls if independent adjustment is intentionally part of the product workflow.

recommendation.title: Adopt the unified picker
recommendation.body: Accept the one-place workflow after a Control UI owner confirms that its recents, progressive destination disclosure, and browser navigation are the desired interaction model.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author supplied the interaction design and is the strongest available routing candidate from the supplied history.
